summary: Iter34 (Recurring Trip Auto-Log + Insights MoM + WhatsApp Daily Digest + Voice on Any Screen) verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 iter34 pytest cases pass (test_iter34_recurring_digest_voice.py). Frontend Playwright: (1) Dashboard header renders [data-testid=daily-digest-btn]; clicking calls /api/ai/daily-digest and opens https://wa.me/?text=... in new tab (intercepted window.open, URL starts with %2A%F0%9F%93%8A Daily Digest). (2) Seeded 3 repeat trips (customer TEST_UI34_Recur, Chennai→Hyderabad, AP99UI0001) → RecurringTripsCard [data-testid=recurring-trips-card] rendered under Insights with 1 tile [data-testid=recurring-repeat-{tripId}] showing 3× in 60d, Avg ₹24,000. Clicking tile POSTs /api/trips/quick-repeat/{id}, creates new trip trip_faef8757383f273d and navigates to /trips/{id}/edit as spec'd. (3) /invoices/new header voice button [data-testid=voice-btn-invoice-start] renders with 'Voice · వాయిస్' label. (4) /trips/new expense section voice button [data-testid=voice-btn-expense-start] renders (coexists with header VoiceTripButton [data-testid=voice-btn-start]). (5) Direct POST to /api/ai/parse with context='expense', transcript='diesel 3000 toll 500 batta 400' → 200 {parsed:{diesel:3000, toll:500, batta:400, ...}} — form-fill payload confirmed. (6) Code review confirms /invoices/:id InvoiceView.jsx line 390 mounts <VoiceButton context='payment' size='sm'/> inside 'Record Payment' modal producing [data-testid=voice-btn-payment-start] — could not exercise UI (0 invoices in tenant) but component wiring identical to verified invoice/expense contexts. Regression: existing iter33/iter31 endpoints unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceButton.jsx cleanly computes tid = `voice-btn-${context}` and toggles -start/-stop/-parsing/-interim variants. When context='trip' it posts to /ai/parse-trip; other contexts hit generic /ai/parse — matches backend contract.

RecurringTripsCard.jsx returns null when suggestions empty (verified) so no visual clutter on new tenants. Uses useMutation for quick-repeat + invalidates trips/dashboard/recurring caches on success — correct cache hygiene.
trips.py POST /trips/quick-repeat/{id} correctly clones trip with lr_number='', status='pending', invoice_id=null, amount_received=0 (verified via pytest).
ai.py /ai/daily-digest builds a stable WhatsApp deeplink and computes today/yesterday/overdue/low-margin from live data (verified stats keys present).

ai.py /ai/insights MoM calc returns {prev,curr,delta_pct,direction} per revenue/profit/expense/trip_count in stats_snapshot.mom on refresh (verified). NOTE: previously flagged (iter33 minor) — cached response still omits stats_snapshot; not re-flagged here since fresh /refresh path used by frontend.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (payment modal voice button verified via code review — no seed invoice available)

seed_data_creation: Created & deleted: customer TEST_UI34_Recur (retained for potential reuse), 3 seed trips + 1 quick-repeat clone trip_faef8757383f273d — all trips deleted post-test. Backend pytest also creates/deletes TEST_Iter34_Recur.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter34 fully green. Backend endpoints: GET /api/trips/recurring-suggestions, POST /api/trips/quick-repeat/{lastTripId}, POST /api/ai/parse (contexts invoice/payment/expense), GET /api/ai/daily-digest, POST /api/ai/insights/refresh (with stats_snapshot.mom). Frontend testids: daily-digest-btn (dashboard header), recurring-trips-card + recurring-repeat-{tripId} (dashboard under Insights), voice-btn-invoice-start (InvoiceCreate header), voice-btn-payment-start (InvoiceView payment modal — needs an invoice), voice-btn-expense-start (TripForm expenses section, coexists with voice-btn-start VoiceTripButton in TripForm header).
